found: the result of .send in function payBonus of ClubVault is not used, so a failed call goes on as if it worked
fix: check the success value, such as (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok, "transfer failed");, or use a library call that reverts on failure

found: tx.origin decides who may act in function sweep of ClubVault; a contract the account calls can pass this check in its name
fix: check msg.sender instead, with an owner or a role, such as require(msg.sender == owner)

found: delegatecall to target, a parameter of function execute of ClubVaultV2: the caller picks the code that runs with the storage and the balance of this contract
fix: delegatecall only to a constant or immutable address, or check the target against a list of trusted addresses that only an authorized party can change

found: the success value of .delegatecall in function runPlugin of ClubVaultV2 is left out of the tuple, so a failed call goes on as if it worked
fix: check the success value, such as (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok, "transfer failed");, or use a library call that reverts on failure

found: delegatecall to plugin, a state variable in function runPlugin of ClubVaultV2: whoever can change plugin picks the code that runs with the storage and the balance of this contract
fix: delegatecall only to a constant or immutable address, or check the target against a list of trusted addresses that only an authorized party can change

found: pragma solidity ^0.8.19 admits more than one compiler version, from 0.8.19 on; the file may be built with a version it was not tested with
fix: pin the version the contracts were tested with, such as pragma solidity 0.8.24;, and check the list of known compiler bugs for it

found: pragma solidity ^0.8.19 admits 0.8.19, below the minimum 0.8.20
fix: move the code to a recent 0.8 compiler and pin it; below 0.8.0, guard every arithmetic operation with checked arithmetic

found: function withdraw of ClubVault writes balances at line 40 after the external call .call at line 38; a contract it calls can enter again before the write
fix: follow Checks-Effects-Interactions: make every change of state before the external call, or guard the function with a reentrancy lock such as nonReentrant

found: function setOwner of ClubVault changes owner and emits no event, so a change of who controls the contract leaves no log
fix: emit an event with the old and the new value, such as OwnershipTransferred(previousOwner, newOwner), in the function that makes the change

found: the for loop in function payAll of ClubVault runs to members.length, an array in storage that can keep growing
fix: bound the work of one call: process the array in pages with a start and a count, let each party pull its own share, or cap the length of the array

found: selfdestruct in function closeClub of ClubVault
fix: remove selfdestruct: it is deprecated, it no longer removes the code on most networks, and in an implementation behind a proxy it can break every proxy; send the balance out with a guarded withdrawal instead

found: pragma solidity >=0.7.0 <0.9.0 admits more than one compiler version, from 0.7.0 on; the file may be built with a version it was not tested with
fix: pin the version the contracts were tested with, such as pragma solidity 0.8.24;, and check the list of known compiler bugs for it

found: pragma solidity >=0.7.0 <0.9.0 admits 0.7.0, below the minimum 0.8.20; before 0.8.0, arithmetic wraps on overflow and underflow with no revert
fix: move the code to a recent 0.8 compiler and pin it; below 0.8.0, guard every arithmetic operation with checked arithmetic

found: block.timestamp goes into keccak256 in function drawWinner of RaffleDraw; the proposer of the block can see and sway the value
fix: use a verifiable source of randomness, such as a randomness oracle with proofs or a commit and reveal scheme, and never a value the block proposer can see or choose

found: ecrecover in function claim of RaffleDraw: the result is not compared with address(0), which ecrecover returns for a signature it cannot read; s is not limited to the lower half of the curve order, so a second valid signature can be made from the first
fix: use a reviewed library such as ECDSA.recover of OpenZeppelin, which rejects address(0) and the upper range of s, and never use a signature itself as the key of a processed message

found: contract ClubVaultV2 inherits Initializable and has no constructor that calls _disableInitializers(), so anyone can initialize its implementation
fix: add a constructor that calls _disableInitializers(), mark initialize with the initializer modifier and the initializers of parent contracts with onlyInitializing, and guard _authorizeUpgrade with onlyOwner or a role

found: external function initialize of ClubVaultV2 has no initializer or reinitializer modifier, so it can be called again
fix: add a constructor that calls _disableInitializers(), mark initialize with the initializer modifier and the initializers of parent contracts with onlyInitializing, and guard _authorizeUpgrade with onlyOwner or a role

found: function _authorizeUpgrade of ClubVaultV2 has no access control modifier and no check of msg.sender, so anyone can upgrade the contract
fix: add a constructor that calls _disableInitializers(), mark initialize with the initializer modifier and the initializers of parent contracts with onlyInitializing, and guard _authorizeUpgrade with onlyOwner or a role

found: the address 0x4242424242424242424242424242424242424242 is written into the code in contract ClubVault; it differs from chain to chain and cannot be changed after the deployment
fix: pass the address to the constructor or the initializer and keep it in an immutable or a guarded variable, or name it in one constant with a comment that says which chain it belongs to

found: external function setFeeCollector of ClubVault changes feeCollector with no access control modifier and no check of msg.sender
fix: guard the function with an access control modifier such as onlyOwner or onlyRole, or check msg.sender at its start; if it is open on purpose, say so in a comment for the review

found: an unchecked block in function sum of ClubVault; arithmetic inside it wraps on overflow and underflow with no revert
fix: keep in an unchecked block only arithmetic whose bounds are checked just before it, and say why in a comment

found: an assembly block in function readSlot of ClubVault; the type checker and the safety checks of Solidity do not reach inside it
fix: keep assembly small and commented, test it on its own, and ask the review to read it line by line

found: external function runPlugin of ClubVaultV2 uses delegatecall with no access control modifier and no check of msg.sender
fix: guard the function with an access control modifier such as onlyOwner or onlyRole, or check msg.sender at its start; if it is open on purpose, say so in a comment for the review
